title: Tripwick Hollow – a Halloween horde-survival game built with Claude Code (Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5) and ChatGPT images
author: Medium_Aspect_8784
selftext:
I made a browser-based horde survival game: you're the last Lamplighter, and the fog, crawling pumpkins and the dead are closing in on a town whose lanterns have all gone out. It's inspired by Tesla vs Lovecraft and Vampire Survivors. You aim and shoot twin-stick style, while your relics (orbiting candles, holy water, crows, scythes) fight alongside you. Level-ups give you a choice of three cards, relics can evolve into stronger versions, and there are nine districts with bosses and a proper ending. Three playable characters unlock as you progress.
    
    How it was made: I made the design, Claude Code wrote nearly all of the code, and ChatGPT made the images. Claude also helped with testing and the trailer. I then spent a couple of days polishing, e.g. a real ending and clock faces that show 13 hours. Opus/Sonnet 5.5 got this to a playable state in 3 days - on earlier projects it took me weeks or months.
    
    Play free in your browser (mouse + keyboard or game controller; no touchscreen yet): https://arcade.tripgeo.com/tripwick
    Trailer: https://youtu.be/zpbqNjzc1Xw
    
    Feedback welcome, especially on difficulty and balance.
